Check the lower blade guide for wear when you change the blade. If the new blade matches the old one in width and pitch, a look will do, and only if you have already run the tensioning procedure. Wear it right. No loose clothing, no jewelry. Tie back long hair.

Wait until the blade stops before you leave the area. The machine stays hot after that. Be careful.
